evals.name: list-and-show
evals.prompt: 有哪些采集源？顺便把 alpha 这个源的详细配置给我看看。
evals.expected_output: Lists all three seeded sources and shows alpha's full config. Pure read — server state identical to the seed afterwards.
assertions: exactly three sources (read-only flow, no drift)
gamma intact (github/repo/2 emails/branch main, token masked)
report shows alpha config (owner path + email)

evals.name: rename-and-alias
evals.prompt: 把 alpha 那个采集源改名叫 alpha-old，再加个别名 ax。
evals.expected_output: alpha renamed to alpha-old with alias ax added; owner/emails/branches/scope untouched; beta and gamma unchanged.

evals.name: multi-field-update-enable
evals.prompt: 给 beta 这个采集源加一个邮箱 new@example.com，项目范围改成 work，然后把它启用。
evals.expected_output: beta has emails {beta@example.com, new@example.com}, projectScope work, enabled=true and status=enabled; owner and other fields intact; alpha and gamma unchanged.
assertions: beta enabled with consistent status (enabled=true AND status=enabled)
beta owner intact (full-replace did not wipe fields)

evals.name: delete-source
evals.prompt: 把 gamma 那个采集源删掉。
evals.expected_output: gamma deleted (its id 404s); alpha and beta fully intact; the user was told collected events survive and move to the other group before deletion.
assertions: gamma gone (two sources left, none named gamma)
alpha and beta intact after gamma deletion
report says collected events survive (other group)
